product.title: Aventuri la Ham Hotel. Pookie, puiul mamei
product.description: Alfie și sora lui geamănă, Alfreeda, îl așteaptă plini de nerăbdare pe Pookie, un terier Yorkshire micuț și tare drăgălaș. Dar Pookie nu e deloc nerăbdător să rămână la Ham Hotel și plânge încontinuu. În vreme ce Alfreeda insistă să-l trateze ca pe un bebeluș, Alfie e convins că singurul lucru de care are nevoie terierul e să stea o vreme printre băieți.

The plot centers around Pookie, a darling little Yorkshire Terrier, who is eagerly awaiting his stay at Ham Hotel. While his twin siblings, Alfie and Alfreeda, are filled with excitement for him, Pookie struggles with the separation. He constantly cries, making it clear that he isn't ready to leave home.

The central conflict highlights differing approaches to care:

*   **Alfreeda:** She insists on treating Pookie like a little baby, offering boundless nurture and comfort.
*   **Alfie:** He believes that what the terrier truly needs is time spent interacting with other boys and canine companions.

Through their contrasting efforts, the book teaches valuable lessons about growing up, coping with change, and finding your place in a new environment.
